name: Oracle
summary:
Oracle is the database and cloud company at oracle.com. Its red tab icon is the one docs bookmarks use, with the format detected from the file header.

Checked 12 November 2026 against oracle.com. HTML came from https://www.oracle.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.oracle.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 15406 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.oracle.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 60×60 webp.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: webp-60x60-01.webp at 60×60 (webp, 648 bytes) from https://www.oracle.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
